Unlock Alphas via Side Mission 001, A Big Ol' Bunnelby: meet Trevelle at Rouge Plaza during Main Mission 05, then catch or defeat the Lv. 10 Alpha in the nearby alley. Catch all species required by the Zone 10 survey first; then refresh ordinary spawns.
notes: Ordinary Lv. 31–33; chance Alpha Lv. 42–44. Pokéarth lists a 5% chance per ordinary spawn slot, not per visit.

Climb the ladder near Espace Vide (published approach), then search the southwestern roofs beside the purple sludge. Check ordinary Arbok rather than the highest fixed Alpha roof. Exact roof-to-roof turns remain unverified.
Look for the larger specimen with red eyes and confirm the Alpha symbol after catching.

If the encounter is missing, use a bench to advance to the next day/night period, then return to the relevant roof, bank or waterway. Nearby spawns refresh; exact individual respawn interval is unverified.
